items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I used to sit in with Julian Lane and all the boys around up there. And I played with them

ctx.x: Did you ever play professionally or just go around sitting in?

Well, in Biloxi. I played, I wouldn't say professional, but I used to sit in with Julian Lane and all the boys around up there. And, of course, Abby wasn't in Biloxi at that time, but he came over quite a bit and married. And I played with them, but I never really got to be able to play the clarinet like the greats, like Fazola and Rap. And stuff like
those fellas so I just threw it on the west side.
